title: Selection toolbar
description: Keep formatting controls anchored to the words being edited.
useCase: Keep formatting controls anchored to the words being edited.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Formats one predefined phrase. Native text selection also opens the toolbar; this is not a full rich-text editor.
look: Pale sage-grey page with a cream rounded card of large olive serif text, one phrase highlighted, and a dark olive floating toolbar above.
motion: Selecting text or pressing the format button fades the toolbar in while it rises 5 px and scales from 0.96 (180 ms ease-out); bold, italic and highlight toggle instantly.
adapt: The toolbar is CSS on `.toolbar` keyed by `data-open` (fade plus `translate(-50%, 5px) scale(0.96)` to rest, 180ms ease-out), opened by the paragraph's `onMouseUp`. It sits at a fixed spot; anchor it to the selection range and replace the demo phrase.
